title: Fred Claus
description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. When Fred's criminal ways finally land him in trouble, Nicholas bails him out and brings him to the North Pole to work off the debt by making toys. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

title: Father of the Bride
description: George Banks (Steve Martin) and his wife, Nina (Diane Keaton), are the proud parents of Annie (Kimberly Williams), but when she returns from studying abroad and announces that she's engaged, their whole world turns upside down, especially that of overprotective George. From meeting the in-laws to wedding plans with an over-the-top consultant (Martin Short) and his flamboyant assistant (B.D. Wong), it seems as if the troubles never end in this update of the classic Spencer Tracy comedy.

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis: Shorts
description: Turning the tables on the locker-room dynamic, athletes from all sports pull pranks on their oblivious teammates and sports-world friends. The team behind Impractical Jokers helps them see the prank through from the opening tip-off to the final buzzer.

title: Impractical Jokers
description: The Jokers are back playing lawyers, trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air. Later, one joker will be getting revenge in an elaborate punishment that the other two are really going to feel.

title: Impractical Jokers
description: The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons; thus the guys must get a bystander to take their side during a heated argument with their fake spouses.

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
description: Anthony Davis pranks the NFL's Jayden Daniels and Braden Fiske during a senior-citizen fitness PSA that spirals when a fight breaks out; while NBA guard Zach LaVine sends MLB ace Blake Snell into chaos with a motion-capture session for a video game skin.

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
description: NBA star forward Tristan Thompson sends NBA superstar guard Darius Garland into an art auction disaster, and Anthony Davis sets up NFL defensive lineman Osa Odighizuwa for a business meeting interrupted by a streaker.

description: Monica and Chandler fondly reminisce about London until a startling revelation leaves Chandler floored.

description: Monica regrets telling a woman about a discount bridal shop when they end up competing for a wedding dress.

description: Joey is overjoyed to be nominated for a "Soapie" award; engaged Monica frets when she realizes she will never experience the thrill of a new relationship again; Ross spots Chandler sneaking out of a male strip club.

description: Joey auditions for a big role which will require him to appear naked; Rachel and Phoebe plan Monica's bridal shower; Ross and Monica's attractive cousin visits and stirs the passions of all men who meet her.

description: Monica and Ross cook Thanksgiving dinner for themselves, but everyone else shows up.

title: Friends

description: Chandler finds out Monica never told her parents he was living with her; Rachel tries her hand at making dessert.

title: Friends
description: Tag joins for Thanksgiving dinner; Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during dinner; Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away.

title: Friends
description: Monica encounters a high-school friend (guest star Brad Pitt) and invites him to Thanksgiving Day dinner.

title: Friends
description: Rachel has a bone to pick with her self-centered sister (Christina Applegate) on Thanksgiving; Monica protects her good wedding china; Joey forgets to join his TV cast mates for the Thanksgiving parade.

title: Friends
description: Monica prepares a Thanksgiving feast for the gang, then becomes enraged when everyone shows up late; Phoebe convinces Rachel to enter Emma in a baby beauty contest.

title: Four Christmases
description: When their plans for an exotic vacation fall apart, unmarried couple Brad (Vince Vaughn) and Kate (Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging around to a quartet of family get-togethers. While Brad counts the hours till he can escape the onslaught of crazy relatives, Kate begins to wonder about her own choices and ponders whether her family members are so crazy after all.

title: Red One
description: When a villain kidnaps Santa Claus from the North Pole, an E.L.F. (Extremely Large and Formidable) operative joins forces with the world's most accomplished tracker to find him and save Christmas.

title: The Wizard of Oz
description: When a tornado rips through Kansas, Dorothy and her dog, Toto, are whisked away in their house to the magical land of Oz. They follow the Yellow Brick Road toward the Emerald City to meet the Wizard, and en route they meet a Scarecrow that needs a brain, a Tin Man missing a heart, and a Cowardly Lion who wants courage. The wizard asks the group to bring him the broom of the Wicked Witch of the West to earn his help.

title: Father of the Bride Part II
description: Just when George Banks (Steve Martin) has gotten used to his daughter, Annie (Kimberly Williams), being married, she announces that she's pregnant, making him an impending grandfather. Shaken by nearing this new milestone in his life, George soon has to process even more surprising news -- his wife, Nina (Diane Keaton), is pregnant too. Reeling from these revelations, George gets help from the eccentric Franck (Martin Short), who, conveniently, has moved from planning weddings to baby showers.

title: A Christmas Carol
description: Dickens' Ebenezer Scrooge (Patrick Stewart) receives visits from three Christmas spirits who show him his past, present and future.

title: American Dad!
description: Despite Francine's warning, Stan gives Steve a gun for Christmas; Steve accidentally shoots Santa Claus.

title: American Dad!
description: The Smith family moves into a hotel after Roger releases lethal gas into their home; Francine gets a job in construction.

title: Impractical Jokers
description: The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons; they take a ride through the park; after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.

title: Impractical Jokers
description: The Jokers are back pretending to be overnight watchmen who don't know when to call it quits, before rallying bystanders to take their side in an unlawful arrest; but one loser has to face a punishment that brings out his feminine side.

title: Impractical Jokers
description: The Jokers are back as wacky inventors pitching a whole new line of AI-themed gadgets; they fill out bogus incident reports with unsuspecting deli customers; the loser will be forced to demonstrate mentally absurd and physically grueling apps.

title: Impractical Jokers
description: The Jokers' mothers visit as overprotective parents meeting a Joker's girlfriend; a Joker must convince a stranger to pose as his girlfriend for a Broadway outing with his mother.

description: The reception following Monica and Chandler's wedding is almost upstaged by the news that a member of the group might be pregnant.

description: The real father of Rachel's baby is revealed; Monica and Chandler struggle to make their honeymoon flight.
